name: 個別会話の共有物と保存方針パネル
prompt:
Correct the first candidate while retaining its accurate Japanese copy, original icon silhouettes and crisp row contents. Use the attached native preview as the exact 390×514 placement guide, the original screenshot crop as the controlling reference for icon geometry and source appearance, and candidate 1 only as the starting point.

Make the page background one perfectly flat solid #F5F5F5 and all card fills perfectly flat #FFFFFF. Remove the visible grain, glow, gradient and tonal variation from both background and cards. Preserve the same fine gray separators, dark labels, gray values/subtitle, and light gray chevrons.

Align the three white card groups to the native preview's vertical locations on the 390×514 canvas: group 1 approximately y=6–130, group 2 y=158–330, group 3 y=369–498. In candidate 1 the first group started too low (around y=40) and was too short; move it up about 32px and increase its height to about 124px. Keep group 2 and group 3 close to their guide positions and preserve row heights. Do not stretch any icons or text. Keep side margins consistent with the original screenshot.

Copy exactly, with no new text:
1. photo icon, 写真・リンク・資料, value 3件
2. star icon, 保存したメッセージ, value なし
3. bell, 通知, value 設定する
4. original palette icon, 会話の背景, value 設定する
5. save-to-photos tray, 写真に保存, value 保存しない
6. original timer icon, 消えるメッセージ, value オフ
7. original document icon, 文字起こしの言語, subtitle 日本語, value 設定

No header, status bar, footer, logo or phone home indicator. The word リンク in the first row is ordinary menu-label text. There are no actual hyperlinks, so keep every label near-black #1D1D1D, every value/subtitle gray #6E6E6E, and do not introduce blue text. Render a clean, flat, faithful iOS interface.
reviewNotes: Second candidate corrects the middle group placement; first and third groups remain vertically misaligned and subtle surface texture remains after two attempts.
